sources.title: GitHub - kherin/karoguard-adtc-2026-submission
sources.snippet: KaroGuard is a compact agricultural decision-support model for smallholder farmers in Mauritius and other cyclone-exposed African and Indian Ocean communities. It runs locally through llama.cpp after the model is downloaded.
